jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
Bij Zorg\&Co Services bouw je apps en webapplicaties die zelfstandige zorgprofessionals en onze collega’s helpen in hun dagelijkse werk. Je krijgt ruimte om technische keuzes te maken en ideeën naar een werkend product te brengen. Je zwaartepunt ligt bij app en frontend; daarnaast werk je mee aan onze .NET\-backend. AI is een vast onderdeel van onze werkwijze: je gebruikt het actief om sneller te ontwikkelen, te testen en releases voor te bereiden.

Wat je gaat doen

* Je ontwikkelt gebruiksvriendelijke apps voor iOS en Android en moderne webapplicaties.
* Je vertaalt gebruikersbehoeften naar duidelijke schermen en herbruikbare componenten, met aandacht voor toegankelijkheid en snelheid.
* Je zorgt dat de ervaring ook klopt bij laden, fouten, ontbrekende gegevens en een slechte verbinding.
* Je bouwt samen met onze backenddeveloper aan API’s, bedrijfslogica en SQL en helpt bij integraties.
* Je test je werk, beoordeelt code en draagt bij aan betrouwbare releases, monitoring en het oplossen van productieproblemen.

Het team en de techniek

Je werkt in het IT/Project team samen met een backenddeveloper, data engineer, businessanalist en CTO. Onze technische basis bestaat uit C\#/.NET, SQL en Azure. Daarnaast werken we met Dynamics 365, Databricks en Power BI. Voor de mobiele app gaat onze voorkeur uit naar React Native en voor web naar React met TypeScript. Je denkt mee over de verdere inrichting en onderhoudbaarheid.

Waar je terechtkomt

Zorg\&Co is een netwerk van coöperaties en ondersteunende services voor zelfstandige zorgprofessionals en zorgorganisaties. Zorg\&Co Services verzorgt onder meer IT, administratie en communicatie. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor op Business Park Stein in Elsloo werken ongeveer 40 collega’s aan die ondersteuning. Je ziet daardoor van dichtbij wat jouw software oplevert.

Wat je meebrengt

* Je hebt apps en webapplicaties in productie gebracht en kunt laten zien wat je zelf hebt ontworpen, gebouwd en getest.
* Je beheerst moderne frontendontwikkeling, bij voorkeur React met TypeScript. Je hebt mobiele apps voor iOS en Android gebouwd en uitgebracht. Ervaring met React Native heeft onze duidelijke voorkeur.
* Je kunt zelfstandig bijdragen aan .NET\-API’s (middels C\# of andere programmeertalen) en SQL en samen met een collega backendproblemen onderzoeken en oplossen.
* Je werkt zorgvuldig met authenticatie, autorisatie en persoonsgegevens. Je gebruikt Git, code reviews, geautomatiseerde tests en CI/CD.
* Je gebruikt AI actief en dagelijks bij ontwikkelen, testen en het voorbereiden van deployments. Je beoordeelt en test de uitkomsten kritisch, bewaakt kwaliteit en veiligheid en kunt je technische keuzes helder uitleggen.

Mooi meegenomen

Ervaring met .NET MAUI, Azure, Power BI Embedded, Dataverse, Dynamics 365 of systeemintegraties is een pré. Specifieke kennis van onze systemen en de zorgsector kun je bij ons opbouwen.

Wat je van ons krijgt

* €4\.500 tot €6\.000 bruto per maand bij 40 uur, exclusief vakantiegeld, afhankelijk van relevante ervaring en vaardigheden.
* Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op verlenging.
* Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en een bonusregeling.
* Een betaald ChatGPT Business\-abonnement inclusief Codex, plus andere AI\-tools die voor het project nodig zijn.
* Flexibele werktijden en een combinatie van werken op kantoor en thuis, in overleg.
* Ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen, met opleidingsbudget voor relevante trainingen of certificeringen in overleg.
* Invloed op technische keuzes en direct contact met de collega’s voor wie je bouwt.

Solliciteren

Stuur je cv of LinkedIn\-profiel en een korte toelichting op een app of webproject waaraan je hebt bijgedragen. Een portfolio, demo of codevoorbeeld is welkom.

jobs.title: IT / Software Developer
jobs.description:
The IT/ Software Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications and systems that support the company’s operational and business requirements.

The role involves working closely with management, end users, and other departments to understand business needs, develop reliable software solutions, troubleshoot technical issues, and continuously improve existing applications and systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software applications based on business requirements.
* Analyze user requirements and translate them into functional and technical software solutions.
* Develop web\-based, desktop, mobile, or internal business applications as required.
* Write clean, efficient, secure, and maintainable source code.
* Maintain and enhance existing applications, systems, and databases.
* Identify and resolve software bugs, system errors, and performance issues.
* Conduct testing, debugging, and quality assurance before system deployment.
* Develop and maintain databases, queries, reports, and system integrations.
* Integrate applications with APIs, third\-party platforms, databases, and other business systems.
* Develop user\-friendly interfaces and ensure proper application functionality.
* Implement appropriate software security measures, access controls, and data protection procedures.
* Monitor system performance and recommend technical improvements.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to end users.
* Prepare system documentation, technical manuals, user guides, and development records.
* Maintain proper source code version control and backup procedures.
* Participate in software upgrades, migrations, and system implementation projects.
* Coordinate with IT personnel, vendors, consultants, and other departments when necessary.
* Conduct user training for newly developed or implemented applications.
* Ensure that developed systems comply with company IT policies and applicable cybersecurity requirements.
* Protect confidential company, employee, client, and system information.
* Perform other software development and IT\-related duties assigned by management.

**Technical Responsibilities:**

* The Software Developer may be required to work with technologies such as:
* HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript
* PHP, Python, Java, C\#, VB.NET, or similar programming languages
* React, Angular, Vue.js, or other frontend frameworks
* Node.js, .NET, Laravel, Django, or other backend technologies
* MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar databases
* REST APIs and third\-party system integrations
* Git, GitHub, GitLab, or other version\-control platforms
* Cloud\-based systems such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
* Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, SharePoint, or other business platforms
* Reporting and data visualization tools
* Specific technology requirements will depend on the applications and systems used by the company.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of software development principles and programming concepts.
* Knowledge of relational databases and database management.
* Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
* Knowledge of API development and system integration is preferred.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, data protection, and secure coding practices is an advantage.
* **Minimum 5 years of relevant software development experience (preferred).**
* Experience developing business applications, ERP systems, HR systems, accounting systems, dashboards, or similar internal applications is an advantage.
* Previous GCC experience is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Experience handling complete software projects from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance is preferred.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Over Zineps

Bij Zineps bouwen we de agentic layer of global logistics
Wij geloven dat iedere zending – van pakket tot pallet – uiteindelijk door één intelligente softwarelaag moet bewegen. Een platform waarin AI, automatisering en logistieke netwerken samenkomen om wereldwijd verzenden eenvoudiger, slimmer en schaalbaarder te maken.
Onze ambitie gaat verder dan software alleen: bij Zineps bouwen we de agentic layer of global logistics
– de laag waarin autonome AI-agents zelf verzendbeslissingen nemen, workflows orkestreren en de wereldwijde logistiek aansturen.
Vandaag helpen we duizenden e-commercebedrijven en logistieke partners met meer dan 60 carrier-integraties, labelautomatisering, realtime tracking en krachtige verzendworkflows. Maar dat is pas het begin.
Daarom zoeken we een hands-on Head of Engineering
die niet alleen de technische koers van het platform bepaalt, maar ook zelf blijft bouwen aan de fundering van een internationaal softwarebedrijf.

Jouw rol

Je bent een builder én een leider.
Je bepaalt de technische richting van Zineps, bouwt en laat het engineeringteam groeien, en blijft tegelijkertijd hands-on in de codebase. Je zet de standaard – technisch én cultureel – en je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de architectuur, kwaliteit en schaalbaarheid van het platform.
Je krijgt veel vrijheid en eigenaarschap om technische keuzes te maken die jarenlang impact zullen hebben, in nauwe samenwerking met de founders.
Ongeveer:
50% software development (hands-on)
20% architectuur & technische keuzes
15% teamleiderschap, coaching & hiring
15% product- en engineeringstrategie

Wat je gaat doen

De technische visie en roadmap van Zineps bepalen en uitdragen
Zelf schaalbare software ontwerpen en bouwen in C# / .NET
Onze event-driven architectuur doorontwikkelen met Azure Functions, Service Bus en messaging
Meebouwen aan een AI-first platform waarin autonome agents en automatisering centraal staan
Het engineeringteam opbouwen, aannemen en laten groeien

Developers coachen en helpen groeien

Technologie

C# · .NET · Blazor · React · Microsoft Azure · Azure Functions · Azure Service Bus · SQL Server · GitHub Actions · REST APIs · Event-driven architecture · AI integrations

Wie jij bent

Je hebt minimaal 8 jaar ervaring als software engineer, waarvan een deel in een lead-, senior- of leidinggevende rol. Je voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar snelheid, ownership en kwaliteit samenkomen, en je wilt een engineeringorganisatie vanaf de basis mee vormgeven.
Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:
Sterke kennis van C# / .NET
Ervaring met Microsoft Azure
Ervaring met het bouwen van schaalbare backend-systemen
Goede kennis van SQL Server
Ervaring met API-design
Bekend met CI/CD
Ervaring met het leiden, coachen of laten groeien van developers
Frontend-affiniteit (Blazor, React of vergelijkbaar) is mooi meegenomen
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en ownership
Je communiceert helder
Je denkt vanuit productimpact en niet alleen vanuit techniek
Je hebt geen 9-5 mentaliteit

Extra pluspunten

Ervaring met:
AI-productontwikkeling en agentic systemen
Event-driven systemen
Microservices
SaaS-platformen
E-commerce
Shipping of logistiek
Het opbouwen en schalen van engineeringteams

Wat wij bieden

Een sleutelrol als technisch leider binnen een snelgroeiende AI scale-up
Directe eigenaarschap over de technische koers van het platform
De kans om een engineeringorganisatie vanaf de basis op te bouwen
Veel ownership en weinig bureaucratie
Werken aan software die wereldwijd gebruikt wordt
Intensieve samenwerking met de founders
Een ambitieus engineeringteam dat kwaliteit voorop zet
Volledige reiskostenvergoeding
Werken vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam
Marktconform salaris passend bij ervaring, impact en ownership

Waarom Zineps?

Bij Zineps bouw je niet aan de zoveelste SaaS-tool. Je bouwt aan de agentic layer of global logistics
– de infrastructuur achter de volgende generatie wereldwijde e-commerce.
We geloven dat AI een fundamentele rol gaat spelen in logistiek, en we bouwen vandaag aan het platform dat daar de basis voor vormt. Als jij energie krijgt van complexe technische uitdagingen, een team wilt opbouwen, ownership wilt nemen en zichtbaar impact wilt maken binnen een klein, ambitieus team, dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Klaar om mee te bouwen?

Stuur je CV of LinkedIn-profiel, eventueel aangevuld met een korte motivatie, naar khoos@zineps.com.

At Zineps, we're building the agentic layer of global logistics

Our ambition goes beyond software alone: at Zineps, we're building the agentic layer of global logistics

Today, we help thousands of e-commerce businesses and logistics partners streamline their shipping operations through 60+ carrier integrations, automated label generation, real-time tracking, and powerful shipping workflows. But this is only the beginning.

Who You Are

You also have:
Strong knowledge of C# / .NET
Experience with Microsoft Azure

Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Experience leading, coaching, or growing developers
Frontend affinity (Blazor, React, or similar) is a plus

The ability to think beyond code and focus on product impact
A builder's mindset—you don't have a 9-to-5 mentality

Nice to Have

Experience with:
AI product development and agentic systems
Event-driven systems
Microservices
SaaS platforms
E-commerce
Shipping or logistics
Building and scaling engineering teams

What We Offer

A key technical leadership role within a fast-growing AI scale-up
Direct ownership of the technical direction of our platform
The opportunity to build an engineering organization from the ground up
High ownership with minimal bureaucracy
The opportunity to build software used around the world
Close collaboration with the founders
An ambitious engineering team that values quality, speed, and ownership
Full travel reimbursement

Excellent growth opportunities toward VP Engineering or CTO as Zineps scales
We believe in rewarding long-term builders. Outstanding performers who demonstrate ownership and make a significant impact may become eligible for our employee stock option program (ESOP), allowing them to share in the long-term success of Zineps.

Why Zineps?

At Zineps, you're not building just another SaaS product. You're building the agentic layer of global logistics-
the infrastructure behind the next generation of global commerce.
We believe AI will fundamentally reshape the logistics industry, and we're building the platform that will power that transformation. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, want to build a team, take real ownership, and see your work make visible impact within an ambitious team, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
LanguageWire is a global leader in language and content services, dedicated to helping brands achieve their full global potential. Since our founding in 2000, we have continuously evolved and developed unique technology to facilitate seamless multilingual communication. Our worldwide network of language experts, coupled with an intuitive online platform, makes it effortless for brands to translate and manage multilingual content. 
The role you'll play 

We're launching a new team dedicated to modernizing and expanding one of our customer-facing tools — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build it from the ground up. This isn't a legacy product handoff: you'll be joining at the very start, shaping both the technical direction and the team culture from day one. 
The current stack is Vue.js on the frontend and Python on the backend, but we're planning a migration to .NET in the near future. Because of this, we're looking for someone comfortable working across all three — Vue, Python, and .NET — who can help drive that transition while continuing to ship new features. As the senior engineer, you'll take a leading role in architecture decisions, technical direction, and mentoring as the team grows. 
The team you'll be a part of 

You'll be one of the founding members of a brand-new team, led by our Tech Team Lead. We're actively growing the team and expect to bring on a Product Manager and one additional Engineer alongside you. This means you'll have real influence over how the team is structured, how we work, and the technical foundations we build on — it's a rare chance to help define a team's culture and practices from the very beginning, rather than stepping into something already set. 

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by... 

Developing and maintaining applications, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and databases 

Contributing to the architecture, design and implementation of new features and improvements 

Implementing best practices for code quality, testing and deployment automation 

Ensuring high-quality software through active participation in code reviews 

Actively engaging in sprint retrospectives, refinements, daily stand-ups, and other team processes 

Taking full ownership of the products and solutions you develop, eliminating bugs early in the process through TDD/BDD and other tests 

Leveraging AI-assisted development tools and workflows to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining code quality and rigor 

Sharing knowledge and supporting fellow developers, QA professionals, and support teams 

Supporting team leaders with your expertise and assist in customer meetings 

Owning CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless operations 

In one year, you'll know you were successful if... 

You are fully integrated as part of the team and have built strong working relationships. 

You actively contribute to maintaining a positive, collaborative, and knowledge-sharing team atmosphere. 

You take full ownership of products and solutions, having delivered several major features to production with measurable impact. 

You share your expertise by mentoring mid-level and junior developers, helping them grow and succeed. 

You contribute to improving team processes, code quality, and technical decision-making. 

Desired Experience And Competencies 

What does it take to work for LanguageWire? 

What you'll need to bring 

Motivational and engaging with a "can do" attitude, fostering a positive team environment. 

Strong problem-solving and communication skills. 

Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices. 

Extensive experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET 6+, ASP.NET Web API, etc.) 

Experience with Python 

Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration 

Familiarity with asynchronous programming and performance optimization in .NET 

Responsible for front-end codebases using Vue.js and/or TypeScript, collaborating closely with full-stack and frontend developers 

Sound understanding of frontend build tools and state management (Vuex, Pinia, or similar). 

Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices 

Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end). 

Comfortable working in agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and peer mentoring 

Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams, including product, design, and QA. 

DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, etc.), Docker, Kubernetes, cloud services (Azure, AWS, or GCP). 

This will make you stand out 

Knowledge of microservices architecture and event-driven systems 

Proficiency with relational databases, particularly MSSQL and/or PostgreSQL 

Hands-on experience with Entity Framework (EF Core) and LINQ 

Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus) 

Strong focus on testing practices (unit testing, integration testing, test automation) 

Awareness of security best practices in software development 

Ability to mentor others and foster knowledge-sharing within the team 

Our perks 

Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas   

Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture   

International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kiev, Gdansk, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia   

We take care of our people and initiate many social get-togethers from Friday Bars a to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!    

150 great colleagues in the Valencia office belonging to different business departments    

Excellent location in cool and modern offices in the city center, with a great rooftop terrace and a view over the Town Hall Square   

Private health insurance   

We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility, working three days in the office and two days from home. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.   

Working in an international environment—more than 20 different nationalities   

A dog friendly atmosphere    

Big kitchen with access to organic fruits, nuts and biscuits and coffee.

At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people & businesses simplify communication. Our values drive our behavior 

We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.

Full-Stack Software Engineer .NET | C# | Azure

About Us

We are a mobility provider based in Luxembourg, operating public transport, shuttles and on-demand services across the region. Our Digital Factory builds products that help the people behind these services work more effectively.

You will join the Foundry, our small software development team. We bring different areas of expertise, enjoy solving problems together and make time to help each other. We value the way people listen, learn and collaborate as much as the technical knowledge they bring.

About Our Digital Transformation

We are modernising the applications and systems that support our operations, with C#, .NET and Azure at the heart of our software environment and Microsoft Fabric supporting our data foundation.

You will contribute to a varied portfolio of digital products addressing operational and business challenges across the organisation. For example, we are building applications that help teams understand and improve workshop workflows, from welcoming a vehicle and organising maintenance to following work through to completion. We are also developing tools to analyse kilometres travelled without passengers, combining vehicle telemetry, reconciliation of planned and actual journeys, calculation logic and clear user interfaces to help teams investigate differences and identify potential savings.

These are two examples among a broader and evolving portfolio. Our products can combine operational workflows, user-facing applications, system integrations and live or frequently updated vehicle data. This can include location, energy consumption, vehicle condition and other telemetry generated by a connected fleet. The work offers opportunities to solve problems across several technical dimensions and different areas of the business.

About Your Role

You will design, build and improve digital products across the full stack, from user interfaces to backend services, APIs and application databases. Your work will include developing features used directly by operational teams, connecting existing systems and improving the reliability and usability of our applications.

You will also contribute to the shared technical foundations behind these products. This may include reusable services, integration patterns and common components that make future applications easier to build, connect and maintain. The role combines visible product development with deeper engineering work that can benefit several solutions across the organisation.

Understanding the business problem is part of the job. Working with Product Owners, Business Analysts and operational colleagues, you will explore how people work, clarify requirements and help shape practical solutions. You will consider how a change affects the wider workflow, its users and the systems around it, looking for the simplest approach that addresses the underlying need.

You will take ownership of agreed work through development, testing, deployment and production follow-up, with responsibilities suited to your experience. Our Tech Lead and colleagues will support you through code reviews, pairing and regular technical discussions.

You will have access to approved AI tools to support development, learning and exploration. We encourage you to think carefully about what can be delegated to AI, where human judgement is needed and how to verify the results. You remain responsible for understanding and testing what you deliver.

About You

You approach problems with curiosity and initiative. You want to understand why something is needed and are willing to investigate, ask questions and suggest options when requirements leave room for interpretation. You can move work forward independently while recognising when to seek guidance or validate an assumption.

You listen actively and take other people’s perspectives seriously. You bring humility to technical discussions, feel comfortable acknowledging what you do not know and can change your mind when new information reveals a better approach. You communicate progress and difficulties openly, and enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues.

You have hands-on experience building applications with C# and .NET. You are familiar with web interfaces, APIs, SQL and application databases, Git, testing and debugging, and care about building software that is secure, maintainable and reliable.

Hands-on Azure experience is required. Familiarity with a modern frontend framework, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices would be useful.

We welcome earlier-career candidates who meet the core C#, .NET and Azure requirements and demonstrate sound foundations, thoughtful problem-solving and a willingness to learn. You do not need to know every technology on day one. We want to understand how you think, work with others and develop your skills.

English is required. French and German are welcome advantages, but neither is required.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will have contributed useful and reliable features to our operational products and developed a strong understanding of the workflows they support. Your work will help users complete tasks more easily, understand operational issues and make better-informed decisions.

You will have contributed to both user-facing applications and the shared foundations behind them. You will identify gaps before they become problems, explain your technical choices and help the team find solutions that make sense across the wider system.

You will grow into greater technical ownership at a pace suited to your experience, contribute constructively to team discussions and build trust through dependable delivery, curiosity and collaboration.

Why Join Us

We take onboarding seriously. We will spend time introducing you to the business, the products and the people you will work with. You will learn how the team operates, who to speak with and where to find support, allowing you to build context and confidence as you take on greater responsibility.

You will join colleagues who make time to explain, discuss difficult problems and share feedback respectfully. There is room to contribute ideas, ask questions, experiment and learn from one another.

This is a permanent position where you can work on applications used in everyday transport operations, connected vehicle data and technical foundations that support several products. You will see how your work affects people’s time, the quality of their decisions and the reliability of the services they provide.

If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving problems across systems and building useful products with people who care about the outcome, we would be happy to meet you.
